# Founders, Open source technology that works today

Build a company on it. Every row has an MVP or a live example, further along than most startups begin, and all of it open source: take a row and run with it.

This is working technology, not a pitch. It is all open source: take a row and run with it. **You do not need me to.**

[Download the PDF ↓](pdf/sgit-ai__01-founders.pdf)The sheet as handed out in Lisbon. The table below is the same content, in a form a search engine and an agent can read.

## What exists

|  | The capability | What exists today |
|---|---|---|
| 02 | **Share files the host cannot read, with history and a write-only upload link.** Powered by sgit, transfer protocol & browser vault | Live. CLI in beta; write-only intake built, never sold. |
| 03 | **Manage and distribute sensitive data, healthcare is the worked example.** Powered by Vaults on the same runtime | An MVP is built on it. |
| 04 | **Deliver a security report as a vault: evidence per finding, retest scripts, views per audience.** Powered by Report vault on the vault runtime | Designed 26 May. Deliverable shape built; demo specified. |
| 05 | **Explain a specialist domain to a board at its own altitude.** Powered by Boardroom, agent rooms & persona machinery | Original product existed. Agent rooms specified in March; persona generator built in August. |
| 06 | **Briefings for your role, with the evidence behind every line.** Powered by Role-aware briefings on semantic graphs | Live; commercial state not verified in the brief. |
| 07 | **Know what your agents can actually do, and give each one a licence to operate.** Powered by Risk product & free behaviour-policy library | Site v1.10, library and store live. No payment link. |
| 01 | **Turn voice into a debrief, wherever the voice already is.** Powered by Voice Debrief + WhatsApp, file & agent integrations | Live, earning, run with a partner under a signed profit share. |

## Two ways to build a company on it

**On your own.** Instead of *join and work on my thing*: build your thing on top of what is already built. The code is permissive and the documents are CC BY.

**With me, on one of three rungs:**

- **One · Direct hire.** Cash per mini project. Lowest commitment, both ways.
- **Two · Revenue share.** Time-boxed, no entity. Voice Debrief runs this way: 90 days; a quarter on net receipts; an even split of what remains. Either party may continue or fork on exit.
- **Three · A company.** Shares and equity. Highest commitment, both ways.

Everything is open, so there is almost nothing to protect: **the agreement collapses to the split, the term, and a short list of sensitive items.**

**Write to [dinis.cruz@owasp.org](mailto:dinis.cruz@owasp.org)**, or explore [the network](../network/index.md).
